name: lib_layered_config
description: Load layered, cross-platform application configuration in Python (defaults, app, host, user, .env, environment variables) merged into one immutable object with provenance and profiles. Ships the python-layered-config skill: install and use the library and CLI, design config files, compute env-var override names, manage per-OS paths and profiles, and find out which layer and file a setting came from.
